description.value: Welcome to our boutique resort in Kabalana, Sri Lanka. In Panta Rei you can escape the hustle and bustle of daily life and immerse yourself in a tropical paradise where surfing, yoga, crystal blue beaches and rainforests come together. The resort features 16 beautiful bungalows, each has its own unique charm and style inspired by wild nature and made from natural materials. Our delicious restaurant and bar offer a variety of tastes, both from local and international cuisines, perfect for fueling up after a day of adventure or winding down with a sunset cocktail. Choose between relaxing by the large pool, strech- ing out in the stylish yoga shala, or surfing the waves of Kabalana. Enjoy Panta Rei.

group_hosting.value: Planning to bring a big group to Sri Lanka? Whether it’s for yoga, surfing, or simply soaking up the chilled island vibes, our resort is ready to host you. We’ll take care of all the meals and accommodation, so you can focus on what matters most—enjoying every moment together.

explore_page_text.value: Things to Do on Sri Lanka’s South Coast. Discover surfing, beaches, yoga, food, and unforgettable experiences along Sri Lanka’s south coast. Stay at Panta Rei Resort and explore it all from a perfect central location. Surfing: Kabalana, Weligama and Midigama offer some of the best surf spots for all levels. Beaches: Enjoy golden sands, palm views, and sunsets across Kabalana, Mirissa and beyond. Yoga & Wellness: Daily yoga classes and wellness experiences in peaceful tropical settings. Explore & Day Trips: Visit Galle Fort, go whale watching, and explore hidden beaches. Food Scene: Enjoy local Sri Lankan flavors and vibrant cafés along the coast. … FAQ: How far is Panta Rei Resort from the beach? The resort is located just a few minutes from Kabalana Beach.

quotes.text: We stayed here in January, and of all the places we've stayed on our travels, this was the best resort so far. Incredibly clean throughout, you can tell housekeeping is taken seriously here, and the whole place is managed to a standard you rarely find. One of the owners was around during our stay, and you could immediately tell how much he genuinely cares about the resort and his guests, on top of being a very friendly guy. The employees match that energy: attentive, warm and top notch across the board. Can't recommend Panta Rei enough, we'll be back.
quotes.author: Peter

quotes.text: I had a lovely stay! The food was excellent, and the staff were incredibly welcoming, friendly and attentive throughout my visit. Everyone made me feel comfortable and well looked after. Thank you for such a pleasant experience!
quotes.author: Lynette
quotes.owner_reply: Thanks for the lovely review Lynette! We really appreciate it and we’re so glad you felt looked after, we all loved having you to stay :)

quotes.text:
We had an amazing stay in Panta Rei. The room was spacious, quiet, and nicely decorated. The food was extremely tasty.
A big shout-out to the incredible staff, always helpful and kind. We really felt at home.
quotes.author: Arianna, Italy

quotes.text: Everything thing was amazing, the room was clean, the pool was beautiful, the food was amazing, the staff are amazing, always very warm and welcoming
quotes.author: Oishanee, India

quotes.text: The hospitality and the atmosphere was great. The staff were very helpful as well.
quotes.author: Akhila, Sri Lanka

quotes.text: Incredible! We stayed at Panta Rei for 1 week, and it was wonderful. The room was very clean and had all the necessary amenities, the pool and garden area was beautiful and very quiet, the food was impeccable, one of the best we ate in Sri Lanka. The workers are very helpful and attentive. We would definitely choose it again if we return to Sri Lanka!
quotes.author: Alba R

existing_site.notes: Phones get a Wix mobile layout (viewport width=320). Faults a visitor meets: (1) home page is four image tiles with one word each and 140 words of text; no room, price or location detail on the first screen; (2) all four room cards on /ourrooms open with the same Booking.com sentence 'Situated in Ahangama Central, 300 metres from Kabalana Beach…'; (3) /explore (title 'Expolore') holds only an embedded HTML iframe: generic 'Things to Do on Sri Lanka’s South Coast' copy with an FAQ and five stock photos loaded at full original size from images.unsplash.com and image2url.com; the same iframe also loads on /restaurant on phones; its text is not part of the page for search engines; /menus and /room-information are empty pages still in the sitemap; (4) the email shown as hello@pantareiresort.com links to pantareiresort@gmail.com, and on Activities to the Wix placeholder info@mysite.com; (5) no room prices anywhere; (6) the home footer link 'room' opens the in-room guest guide PDF, which publishes the guest Wi-Fi password; (7) the engine's logo link is broken ('https://pantareiresort.holidayfuture./') and its ratings are stale (4.8 / 9.1); (8) ~15.7 MB transferred on first load and nine third-party hosts (Sentry, visitor-analytics.io, image2url.com, Unsplash, Google Maps, Google Fonts); (9) stock images on About, Activities and Explore (a Buddha statue on a headland, string lights, four Unsplash beach/food photos, an image2url.com surfer) next to their own professional photography; (10) the Surf Therapy Massage and full menus with prices exist only inside PDFs.
